character_images_needed: Old Lady (There Was an Old Lady series)
notes: This is a cumulative repetitive book ideal for AAC — the phrase 'she swallowed the ___ to catch the ___' repeats throughout. Key vocabulary follows Thanksgiving dinner items and objects the old lady swallows (turkey, stuffing, corn, pie) plus clothing/toy items used in some versions (hat, boot, ball). 'Swallow' is the central action verb and should be clearly depicted as an eating/gulping action. 'Belly' refers to her transparent stomach which is central to the visual humour. If the specific illustrated version used in class is by Lucille Colandro with art by Jared Lee, the old lady has a very distinctive look — sourced clip art will greatly aid recognition.
